newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTE WINS FIM 70 MLN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: RAUTE WINS FIM 70 MLN ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Raute Oy said in a statement on Monday its Raute Wood unit won two orders for laminated veneer lumber (LVL) production lines worth a total of 70 million markka.

One order was from Finnforest Oy, a unit of Finnish forest industry group Metsaliitto, and the other was from an unamed customer in Japan, Raute said, but did not give the values of the different orders.
Both production lines will have annual capacities of 40,000 cubic metres and will be delivered in winter 1998, it said.
